---
# Industry / NGO resume (2 pages). No grades or hours; leads with outcomes.
title: ""
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    includes:
      in_header: ../assets/preamble.tex
  word_document: default
geometry: margin=0.6in
fontsize: 10pt
mainfont: Carlito
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis")
source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "..", "R", "cv.R"))
cv <- load_cv()
```

```{r}
render_header(cv)
```

# Summary

```{r}
cat(esc(squish(cv$profile$summary$industry)), "\n\n")
```

# Experience

```{r}
render_experience(cv, roles = "nasa-esds-pe", max_priority = 2, n = 8, summaries = TRUE)
render_experience(cv, roles = "nasa-ecocon", max_priority = 2, n = 4, summaries = FALSE)
render_experience(cv, roles = "usgs", max_priority = 2, n = 2, summaries = FALSE)
render_experience(cv, compact = c("unl", "iiasa", "uf-grad"), roles = character(0))
```

# Education

```{r}
render_education(cv)
```

# Recognition

```{r}
render_awards(cv, max_priority = 1, amounts = FALSE)
```

# Open Science and Software

```{r}
render_pub_line(cv)
cat("Author or co-author of ", length(cv$software), " open-source software tools, including `bbsAssistant` (USGS software release). github.com/", cv$profile$github, "\n\n", sep = "")
```
